briefdescription.para: The integrals over the smoothing domain of a particle in its section: its volume, the smoothed gradients of the shape functions, its second moments and the face loads, one implementation for the SQCNI, SNNI, NSNI and SDI particles of both families; and the hoop terms of the axisymmetric weak form. The axisymmetric derivation is on the page "Axisymmetric Particles" of the documentation.
